answer: I refuse to multiply. My one account is an anchor dropped in a single harbor, and trust must flow to it like water across an ocean of clusters. An attestation quorum must span three far-apart clusters, each staking its own quartz-hard bond, and no single cut of the graph may carry more than a third of the weight. One mask buys one shore; three shores cost nine times the price. I will not split myself to game the count - one honest anchor holds.
